notes: CONFLICT resolved: titles used; ch:genotype and ch:treatment are wrong (checked against expression of osmY, dps, otsB, gadB, proV, deaD). All labels are read from the title (genotype, series, time point); ch:genotype and ch:treatment are ignored. Time 0 of every series = culture at OD600 ~0.3 in LB sampled before the stressor: treatment none, mid_exponential (inferred from OD), 37 C. Wild-type time-0 samples of all three series are controls. Low temperature = shift to 15 C, high osmolarity = NaCl addition; exposure acute (30 min), short (60-120 min), adapted (150-300 min); these keep mid_exponential up to 120 min (inferred, pre-shift phase), later samples no phase. Stationary-phase series: no stressor applied (continued growth), treatment none; the text gives no phase per time point (only 'transition from exponential to stationary phase' for the series), so growth_phase is left out after time 0. Replicate names SP_/LSP_ (stationary) and short_/long_ (cold) are not explained in the text. WT re-read: wild-type BW27786 with no stated modification -> wild_type.
